description: JavaScript module defining templates and functionality for a Bootstrap WYSIWYG HTML editor, including toolbar creation, command execution, and localization.

classes.name: Wysihtml5
classes.description: Main class managing the creation and operation of the WYSIWYG editor, including toolbar setup and event handling.

methods.name: createEditor
methods.description: Initializes the wysihtml5 Editor instance with given options.

methods.name: createToolbar
methods.description: Builds the toolbar DOM element with buttons and dropdowns based on options.

methods.name: initHtml
methods.description: Sets up the HTML view toggle button.

methods.name: initInsertImage
methods.description: Sets up the image insertion modal and related commands.

methods.name: initInsertLink
methods.description: Sets up the link insertion modal and related commands.
